## Description

Summary of the changes introduced in this pull request.

## Type of Change

- [ ] feat: New feature
- [ ] fix: Bug fix
- [ ] refactor: Code improvement without behavioral change
- [ ] test: Unit or integration test addition
- [ ] docs: Documentation update
- [ ] chore: Maintenance or tooling update

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] pnpm lint passed cleanly
- [ ] pnpm typecheck passed with zero errors
- [ ] pnpm test passed with high coverage
- [ ] No em dashes, uppercase transforms, or letter-spacing styles introduced
- [ ] All new text is translated in bn.json and en.json
- [ ] Money calculations verified with decimal.js
- [ ] Security rules followed: no IDOR, mess scoping verified, inputs whitelisted
